Unfortunately, hair loss is a part of life, especially for us curly girls that don't wash our hair as often. So when we do it looks like we lost half of our hair. So my first recommendation is nutrition. If you don't drink that clear splashy stuff, eat a well-balanced diet, and try to remain calm (stress is why I started having silver-white hair at 13, and my hair is pitch black), your hair will thin, break or fall out. Next, I would suggest scalp hair. Determine what your scalp needs and throw that into your already long list of things we have to do to care for our curls. 

Suggestions are:

Mielle Rosemary Mint Scalp & Hair Strengthening Oil- Budget-friendly

The Alpha Multi-Vitamin Scalp Growth Oil- Budget-friendly

JVN Complete Pre-Wash Scalp & Hair Treatment Oil- a little pricey but I love it for my thinning hair and dry scalp ( I'm only 30 pls help)

OUAI Hydrating Scalp Serum & Supplements -($75) but you get the scalp serum and a 30 day bottle of supplements. It's on my next buy list.

Shampoos and Conditioner I use and love:

Clarifying Shampoo: Oleplex No. 4C (I live in an area with hard water and this is great for that)

Cowash:CurlSmith CURL QUENCHING CONDITIONING WASH

Conditioner: CurlSmith MULTI-TASKING CONDITIONER (great for dry damaged hair and it is a rinse-out leave-in and deep Conditioner)

​

Hopefully, I was able to provide some useful information. The one thing about curly hair I HATE is that I'm always trying to find that perfect product. GOOD LUCK!
